brands.name: Pepper Shapes
brands.location_label: Long Jetty, New South Wales, Australia
brands.short_description: Low-production, high-quality surfboards from a family shaping bay in Long Jetty on the Central Coast of New South Wales since 2009.

models.name: DK's Special Sauce
models.description: A design collaboration with surfer Daniel Kerr. A long board for the progressive logger. Beautiful pig outline with its wide point back. Features of the special sauce are the teardrop nose concave, that makes for a more locked in feeling through nose rides. Also features a scoop deck concave on the deck of the tail which helps with leverage through turns. A great board for the progressive logger. Available from 9'0 - 9'8.

models.name: Keel Fish
models.description: Peppers take on the traditional keel Fish is a balanced blend of traditional and modern surfboard design to create a high performance twin fin fish. It's down rails and single to double concave makes for effortless speed and drive. A great board for flowing lines and drawn out turns.

models.name: Midstrength
models.description: Fast and flowy. This mid length single fin is a great and reliable all rounder. Perfect for beginners to the high performers. Great for clean open faces and down the line point breaks off the east coast. Think flowing high lines transitioning to longer rail turns. The 60's inspired egg style plan shape creates a classic vibe of lasting worth. A mostly flat bottom into subtle double vee concave in the back, tucked bottom rail into a soft edge for a fast and lively feel under the feet.

models.name: Noserider
models.description: A modern log designed for maximum tip time. Features a balanced plan shape that keeps its width through to the nose creating stability when cross stepping. A wide square tail with late tail lift creates a locked in sensation through nose rides. Available from 9'0 to 9'8 and in 2 different tail variations available square tail or rounded pin.

models.name: Noserider Rounded Pin
models.description: A modern log designed for maximum tip time. Features a balanced plan shape that keeps its width through to the nose creating stability when cross stepping. A wide square tail with late tail lift creates a locked in sensation through nose rides. Available from 9'0 to 9'8 and in 2 different tail variations available square tail or rounded pin.

models.name: Pearl
models.description: A traditional Noserider specific Log. Custom rocker features extra tail flip, set fin at 80mm from the tail that ensures no slipping out on a steep nose ride section. The Pearl comes with timber tail block and colour resin panels applied in the final filler coat, to create a period correct aesthetic. Length is your friend with this design. Available from 9'6 to 10'1.

models.name: Pelagic Fish
models.description: The Pelagic fish is a fast & responsive twin plus trailer fin hybrid shortboard. From 1 foot to 5 foot, it's a peak performing fish that's got plenty of get up and go speed. Featuring a S deck curve, low entry rocker, single to double concave, subtle beveled down rails and subtle flyers into a pulled in swallow tail. This design makes for an amazing experience when high performance surfing.

models.name: Sea Dart
models.description: A classic pintail involvement style long board. Featuring a pig like plane shape, wide point back and apex nose entry makes for smooth trim. Pinched rails and nose concave blending to a rolled bottom and a unique rocker curve with late tail lift. Created for fast and smooth transitions through turns and has great nose riding.

models.name: The Blender
models.description: Our Hybrid High Performance Longboard model developed with surfer Grant Ferguson. The outline is nicely balanced with more area forward that pulls in through the bottom half to a rounded pin tail, flatter tail rocker with double vee concave and a hard resin edge in tail that creates fast transitions through turns and top to bottom rail surfing. Comes with a single fin box and side fin boxes in either future or fcs2 boxes.

models.name: The Warbler.
models.description: A user-friendly longboard for the progressive longboarding enthusiast. The sleek foils make for effortless transitions though turns and wonderful nose riding capabilities. Suited for beachies to point breaks. My everyday go-to longboard

models.name: Wilder Twin Fin
models.description: The Wilder Twin is the ultimate all round surf craft, it performs in any conditions from 1 ft to well overhead. The deep double concave through to the large swallow tail gives you the hold you need to push as hard as you can on those big turns and the low level rocker combined with the twin fin helps maintain speed in smaller conditions, it has lots of volume up front around the chest area for easy paddling to keep your wave count up, if you're after a board to suit all kinds of conditions this is the board for you. Available from 6'6 to 7'6.
